commands.name: format
commands.details: Formats all TypeScript and JavaScript files using Biome's fast formatter.

commands.name: check-all
commands.details: Runs tests, type checking, and linting in sequence. Fails fast on first error.
commands.onError: Check which step failed: tests (assertions), tsc (types), or eslint (style). Fix issues in that order.

commands.name: e2e
commands.details: Runs Playwright E2E tests against your application.
commands.onError: Ensure the app is running. Check playwright.config.ts for baseURL. Run 'npx playwright install' if browsers are missing.
